//: This project's settings for the Launchwright guard (launchwright/guard/guard-lib.mjs reads them). They only ever add to what the guard refuses; the built-in rules hold whatever this file says. Agents may add the user's answers here with a file edit (a key's name, where real users' data lives, text the user approved), but never take anything away; the guard refuses that.
//workingBranch: The one branch agents push to. Set it to null if a push to it builds or deploys: then only the user pushes.
//productionBranches: Branches that deploy to production, on top of release and production.
//keyNames: The names of this project's keys in the environment, such as STRIPE_SECRET_KEY. Never printed or expanded.
//keyFolders: Folders besides the project folder and app/ that hold .env files.
//userDataPaths: Files and folders holding real users' data, such as exports. Never read, copied, changed or committed.
//userDataHosts: Hosts holding real users' data, such as the production database's. Never reached from the command line.
//productionScripts: package.json scripts that deploy, release, update or submit, beyond the ones whose names start with deploy, release, submit, publish, ship, upload or launch.
//protectedPaths: More files and folders only a kit update or the user changes.
//approvedText: Text the user approved, such as store answers or the privacy policy: never changed without asking again. A new version goes in a new file.
//refusedPrograms: More programs agents never run, each with the reason they see.
//refusedHosts: More hosts agents never reach from the command line, each with the reason they see.
//easWorkflows: Expo workflow files agents may start with eas workflow:run, such as a test run. Only the user adds to this list.
//tests: This project's own cases for the guard's test: commands it must refuse, and everyday commands it must allow.
